ownRead.statement:
### E09 — Pecora et al. (2014)

**Cluster synchronization and isolated desynchronization in complex networks with symmetries**  
Nature Communications 5, 4079. DOI: [10.1038/ncomms5079](https://doi.org/10.1038/ncomms5079)

**Classification:** supports core / domain-specific realization.  
**Evidence:** Mathematical derivation plus electro-optic experiment.  
**Existing clauses:** §3, §5, §7.

Network symmetries predict collective clusters and their dynamical changes; experiments test those predictions.

**Scope:** Specified oscillator/network assumptions; they are not added as requirements of RRG.

**Checked:** Full primary author manuscript; publisher metadata cross-checked. Manuscript title differs slightly.  
**Location:** Equations 1–2; group-orbit construction; Figure 3 and block-decomposed variational equations.  
**Inspected source:** https://arxiv.org/html/1309.6605v1
